Chapter 7192: Heavy Sin

Chapter 7192: Heavy Sin

Empress Hong Tian lost her aura and returned to being a regular girl. She closed her eyes and channeled everything into the dao heart - the only thing left.

Her unbreakable will stopped the destructive wing - a move capable of breaking a celestial immortal.

“Is this the so-called immovable dao heart?” Phoenix Queen sighed before attacking with the other wing.

Both wings at once turned Empress Hong Tian into a bloody mess.

“Your dao heart might be indestructible, but not your body and true fate. Your death is assured.” Phoenix Queen spoke.

“Not necessarily.” Empress Hong Tian suddenly opened her eyes.

“Whoosh!” Suddenly, a sword pierced Phoenix Queen’s chest from behind.

She looked back and saw the assailant was none other than Mang.

“Did you see this in the future?” Immortal Emperor Gu Chun sighed and asked.

Mang was under his control and in this key moment, he tried to kill Phoenix Queen.

“I didn’t need to, Phoenix Queen can handle it.” Genesis smiled and shook his head.

Gu Chun felt something was amiss upon hearing this.

“Who will be the last one smiling?” Phoenix Queen smiled beautifully.

“Retreat!” Li Baye shouted and broke free from Octopus.

“Rumble!” He commanded the primordial trees to release more laws to protect the world.

“Boom!” Phoenix Queen and the wings self-imploded, releasing a terrible power.

Fortunately, Li Baye reacted fast enough and coated everything with primordial laws, Empress Hong Tian included.

However, the controlled Mang didn’t release the grip, still wanting to pierce through. As for the emperor, he faced the incoming explosion.

“My sin is heavy, it is time to die.” He closed his eyes and accepted fate.

“Boom!” Both Mang and him were obliterated, completely erased from this world.

Once the dust settled, everyone digested the event. They knew Immortal Emperor Gu Chun betrayed Guardian and joined Devouring, falling into the darkness.

Immortals from Guardian despised him, especially those from the nine worlds. No one expected him to deliver a fatal blow, taking down Phoenix Queen.

Was he a traitor or was this all planned? Nonetheless, perhaps this was the best ending for him - still a worthy emperor from the nine worlds.

“Crackle!” Suddenly, lightning bolts and arcs manifested from the explosion site, coming together to form a figure.

“Phoenix Queen!” This shocked the crowd.

Her eyes contained terrible tribulation bolts, capable of destroying the world.

“Fully let go.” She sighed and said: “The mortal world has nothing to do with me now.”

Despite her pleasant voice, others became afraid.

She landed on a planet and picked up ashes: “Once, I was too reluctant to let go. Today, it is farewell. Phoenix Queen is no more.”

The divine beasts observed her and found that she suddenly became a stranger. In the past, she even sacrificed her dao companion for the sake of the race. Now, the ties have been severed.

“What will your name be then?” An ordinary man appeared out of nowhere and asked.

It was as if he has been there the entire time, just no one was able to see him.
